FactionDef.label: Rim Recovery Partners
FactionDef.description: A collection agency. Polite until it is not.

li.label: drowning in debt
li.description: We owe more than the colony is worth. The post smells of overdue letters.

li.label: broke
li.description: The account is empty. Even the ATM looks at us with pity.

li.label: scraping by
li.description: We have a little in the bank. Very little. Nobody says it out loud.

li.label: comfortable
li.description: Comfortable, and not worried about it.

li.label: savings
li.description: We have savings. It is a strange, warm feeling.

li.label: rich
li.description: We are rich. Not that anyone mentions it at dinner.

li.label: filthy rich
li.description: The colony is filthy rich. We have started buying things we do not need.

li.label: too big to fail
li.description: We are too big to fail. Somebody has to say it and it might as well be us.

li.label: drowning in debt
li.description: Debt. Debt! I can feel every silver coin we do not have.

li.label: broke
li.description: Broke. I did not become greedy to be broke.

li.label: scraping by
li.description: Hardly anything in the account. I check it every hour.

li.label: getting by
li.description: Fine. But it could be more.

li.label: comfortable
li.description: Comfortable. But it could be more.

li.label: savings
li.description: Savings, in a vault, with my name near it. Lovely.

li.label: rich
li.description: Rich! I will not stop counting.

li.label: filthy rich
li.description: Filthy rich. This is what I was born for.

li.label: too big to fail
li.description: Too big to fail. Frame the balance sheet.

li.label: collectors loitering
li.description: Two men in bowler hats are standing near the door. They are very polite about it.
